pages.name: Ender Bee
pages.text: Bubba Star. End, all the time.

Shulker shells: 5 ender combs, a diamond and 3 chests.$(br2)$(l)Flowers:$() End Stone, Purpur Block, Purpur Pillar, Chorus Plant, Chorus Flower$(br2)$(l)Home biome:$() every End biome$(br2)$(l)Brings home$() (busy hive):$(li)Ender Honeycomb: every trip, 210 per hive-hour$(br2)$(l)Blink:$() Teleports a short way when hurt.
$(l)Waterproof:$() Takes no damage from water (it still stays home in the rain).
Use it on a vanilla bee.
